account: In April 2024 the resident representative of the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in Zimbabwe praised the Hurudza AI idea at the Innovative Forum of the Zimbabwe International Trade Fair (ZITF). Hurudza AI is an AI contact center that assists farmers with climate-smart agriculture. In its June 2025 account to the International Telecommunication Union, the Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ) describes pilots in three wards that give agricultural advice by voice and text message. Development was continuing at that time. The account's figures for income, loss reduction and adoption are projections, including a 40% reduction in post-harvest losses. In March 2026 Hurudza AI and Paltech Africa announced solar-powered Farmers' Bench units for the service. Developing Telecoms reported that the joint project was at the pilot phase, with plans to expand across provinces. No source reports how many farmers used the service or what they gained.
